Class ActionSpace

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.core.rl.ActionSpace
public final class ActionSpace extends Object
Seven independent categorical heads, one decision per game tick. Camera deltas use log-spaced bins so the same head can both flick and make sub-degree corrections.
